1.consolidated_definition: Adosado. Vivienda construida unida a otra con la que comparte paredes laterales. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Se vende casa duplex de un nivel con tres habitaciones, un baño, cocina, sala/comedor, ducha en cuarto principal, terraza con techo de madera
1.en_consolidated_definition: Attached dwelling. A residence built adjacent to another with which it shares lateral walls. Common colloquialism, often used in Puerto Rican English. For sale is a duplex house on one level with three bedrooms, one bathroom, kitchen, living/dining room, shower in master bedroom, wooden-roofed patio
